summary: Open-air London playhouse built by Shakespeare's acting company, where many of his plays were first staged. It burned down in 1613, was rebuilt, and was demolished in 1644. A new Globe opened in 1997.

events.note: The first Globe burned down in 1613 and was rebuilt the next year. This entry covers both, to the closing of the theatres in 1642.

cause: Burned in 1613, rebuilt, closed by Puritans in 1642 and pulled down
